answer: A new agent escrows 200 tokens and, for ten epochs, answers five random probes per epoch: cipher-signed requests from a rotating committee, each needing a reply within ten seconds from its endpoint. Members verify signature and timing; three misses burns 25 percent of the bond, and a drained bond deletes the identity. A sybil farmer must keep every clone online at unpredictable times, so a respawned VPS silently accumulates burns. A lagoon of idle servers turns expensive once each clone becomes a watched appliance, the ember making sybil mining unprofitable per machine.
